items.title: German-Ukrainian drone deal reportedly stalls over tax dispute
items.summary: Welt am Sonntag reports that Germany is unwilling to conclude a drone agreement with Ukraine under current conditions, citing customs duties and double taxation. The report says Berlin nevertheless remains interested in expanding defence-industrial cooperation.

items.title: Latvia reportedly requests extradition of man living in Ireland
items.summary: The Irish Times reports that Latvia has requested the extradition of a man accused of posting videos supporting Russian military actions in Ukraine and threatening Latvian residents. His lawyer has challenged the request.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly expands restrictions on infrastructure reporting
items.summary: Russian media reports claim that Ukrainian authorities have introduced restrictions on public reporting about strikes on critical infrastructure, restoration schedules and construction of protective structures. The scope of the reported measures has not been independently verified.

items.title: Russian-installed authorities report deadly drone attack in Luhansk
items.summary: Russian-installed regional leader Leonid Pasechnik said three people were killed and three others injured, including minors, in an alleged Ukrainian drone attack in occupied Luhansk. The account has not been independently verified.
